name: Crusty Bread
notes: Add-in ideas: Gruyere, rosemary, lemon zest; Walnut, cranberry, orange zest; Rosemary & garlic.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.body: Mix together: **3 cups flour**, **1¾ tsp salt**, **½ tsp yeast** and **1½ cups water**. Stir with a spoon.

steps.title: Rest overnight
steps.body: Cover and leave on counter overnight (12-18 hours).

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.body: Heat oven to 450°F with cast iron pot with lid inside.

steps.title: Shape the dough
steps.body: Place dough on a heavily floured surface and shape into a ball. May add add-ins at this point. Cover with plastic wrap.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.body: Remove the pot from the hot oven, place dough in the pot (no oil needed), replace the lid, and place the pot in the oven for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Bake uncovered
steps.body: Remove the lid and bake for 15 more minutes.
